description: The signed-in couple's own guest list on Zola: change the names, mailing address, email, or phone of up to 25 households. Get each guest_group_id, guest_group_version and guest_id from zola_search_my_guests first. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same changes and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Status: preview (nothing changed yet), nothing_to_change (the list already has these values), done (changed), draft_changed or record_changed (the guest list changed, nothing changed: show the new preview and ask again). A call with a used confirm_token returns the stored result. An empty text clears a field. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

changes.description: 1 entry for each household, at most 25

address1.description: The street number and name only, for example 250 Greenwich St. Put an apartment, suite, unit or floor in address2

address2.description: The apartment, suite, unit or floor, for example Apt 4B or Fl 39. Leave it out when the address has none

email.description: An empty text clears the email

guests.description: The name changes of the guests of this household

first_name.description: The new first name. It cannot be empty

last_name.description: The new last name. It cannot be empty

version.description: guest_group_version from zola_search_my_guests. A change of the group after that read stops the preview

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same changes

name: zola_update_my_guest

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a change to the guest list of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the guest list

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_update_my_guest with the same changes, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

record_count.description: The guest groups that the change changes

records.description: The guest groups with a change, in the order of the call

from.description: The value before. Null for a contact field and for an empty value

hidden.description: True for an address, email, or phone: the values are not given

removal.description: True when the change replaces or clears a value

to.description: The value after. Null for a contact field and for an empty value

name.description: The guests of the group, as the couple knows them

version.description: The version of the group as this call read it

removal_count.description: The changes that replace an address, an email, or a phone

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: the guest list has these values. done: changed. draft_changed and record_changed: nothing changed, a new preview with a new confirm_token

title: Update My Guests
